rules.description: Production planning, routing, intent heuristics, prompt text and private evaluation cases. Public planner counterparts become the standalone reference in Phase 3.
Private tooling, runtime compatibility and production planner regressions.
Common policy utilities and regression suites; maintain identical copies in both repositories independently of the runtime pin.
Private repository enforcement and the temporary bridge to public execution. Shared startup/ownership utilities are vendored from public.
Temporary import and application bootstrap; each retained shim needs a manifest exception.
Public app and implementation tests. Private copies remain only for runtime compatibility until Phase 4; the Active migration freeze still applies.
Platform, governed arithmetic, evidence/claim validation, read adapters and other application code; no new private copies.
Shared harness and platform tooling. Private repository tooling is maintained in its owning repository, outside the application-copy check.

mixed_capabilities.private: Production prompt text; extraction behind the package hook is Phase 3.

mixed_capabilities.public: execute_plan, leader_game_floor, normalize_duplicate_rank_plan and single_period_rank_plan remain shared execution, qualification and scope validation. A standalone reference planner is public.
mixed_capabilities.private: Production planning only; private version delegates the shared functions.
